rationale: The position has registered zero maximum favorable excursion in five full minutes — price never once traded at or below the short entry of $14.78 — signaling the bearish thesis has failed to attract any follow-through selling. The last four candles are a tight consolidation band ($14.80–$14.96) with the heaviest-volume bar (49K) closing at $14.85, neutral rather than directionally confirming downside, and price continues to sit above both the entry and the 9-EMA at $14.90. With no MFE and a structurally choppy tape, the expected value of holding has degraded sufficiently to warrant an orderly exit rather than waiting for the invalidation at $15.32 to be tested.
